description: Building Canada Fund - Provincial-Territorial Base Fund is a dataset listed in Ontario open data catalogue, an open data portal, published or maintained by Infrastructure. The Provincial-Territorial Base Fund (PT-Base) fund infrastructure projects across 17 project categories, including critical infrastructure (e.g. drinking water) and infrastructure that promotes economic growth (e.g. broadband). Eligible applicants include the province, municipalities and public sector bodies. This dataset shows the application stage for the 2007 PT-Base intake. Coverage: Ontario. The portal files it under the publisher Infrastructure. Its tags are Economy and Business, Gouvernement, Gouvernement et finances, Government, Government and Finance. The portal shows 2021-01-15 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support infrastructure planning and operations studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-ontario-portal.
